headline: A global semiconductor selloff sparked by China's CXMT memory-chip claim collides with mostly-solid big-bank earnings, splitting the market sharply between tech and financials at the open.

Tech fractures under chip selling and oil pressure as the Dow quietly rotates higher — the real test arrives Tuesday morning when six mega-cap earnings prints and the opening of Q3 bank season hit the tape simultaneously.

Tech snaps back on the AI-revenue clarification while Hurricane Isaias and the SpaceX telecom shock keep risk-off currents running just below the surface — bank earnings and CPI next week are the real verdict.
AI demand doubts plus oil and yields hit chips and growth — Delta and CPI are the next two decision points
Stocks retreat from records as Brent near $102 and a 24-year yield high revive Fed-hike fears — FOMC minutes and Thursday's PepsiCo print are the next decision points
